intro: The Glazed Salmon at CAVA is a premium protein option featuring a perfectly baked salmon fillet topped with a savory herb glaze. Available on the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains), this flavorful seafood choice delivers 320 calories and 23g of protein, making it an excellent centerpiece for customizable bowls and pitas. The tender, flaky fish is enhanced with aromatic herbs for a restaurant-quality experience.
priceCalories: Glazed Salmon costs an additional $4.50 to $5.50 above the base bowl or pita price, depending on location and portion size. At 320 calories with 23g protein, 23g fat, and just 5g carbs, it offers substantial nutrition for the premium price. This protein-rich option is competitively priced compared to other premium selections on the [full CAVA menu](/), providing excellent value for seafood lovers.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this salmon apart is the signature savory herb glaze that enhances the natural richness of the baked fillet. Unlike plain grilled proteins, the glaze adds layers of flavor with aromatic herbs that complement the fish perfectly. The salmon is carefully baked to maintain moisture and flakiness, creating a premium dining experience. This preparation method ensures consistent quality across all [CAVA Locations](/locations).
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Glazed Salmon contains 320 calories with a balanced macro profile of 23g protein, 23g fat, and 5g carbohydrates. The high protein content supports muscle maintenance while the healthy omega-3 fats from salmon promote heart health. With minimal carbs, it fits various dietary preferences including low-carb and keto plans. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) for complete meal totals.
whatsInside: This dish features a premium salmon fillet that is oven-baked to perfection and finished with a proprietary savory herb glaze. The glaze combines aromatic herbs and seasonings that enhance the natural flavor of the fish without overwhelming it. The salmon is sourced for quality and prepared fresh daily. The simple yet refined ingredient list ensures clean eating while delivering exceptional taste.
tasteLike: Glazed Salmon offers a rich, buttery flavor profile with herbaceous notes from the savory glaze. The fish itself is tender and flaky, melting on your tongue with natural sweetness. The herb glaze adds earthy, aromatic complexity with hints of garlic and Mediterranean spices. The combination creates a satisfying umami experience that pairs beautifully with fresh vegetables and grains from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings).
customize: Build your perfect bowl by pairing Glazed Salmon with bases like SuperGreens, Brown Rice, or Cauliflower Rice from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases). Add spreads like Roasted Red Pepper Hummus or Crazy Feta from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads). Complete your creation with fresh toppings, pickled vegetables, and light dressings. The salmon works beautifully in both bowls and pitas for versatile meal options.
pairsWell: This premium protein pairs exceptionally with Mediterranean-inspired toppings like cucumber, tomato, red onion, and feta cheese. The [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) offers complementary options like Lemon Herb Tahini or Greek Vinaigrette that enhance the salmon without overpowering it. For sides, consider the Mediterranean Quinoa Salad or Pita Chips from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) to complete your meal with balanced flavors and textures.
healthyChoice: Glazed Salmon is an excellent choice for health-conscious diners seeking quality protein and beneficial omega-3 fatty acids. With 23g of protein per serving, it supports satiety and muscle health while providing heart-healthy fats. The low carbohydrate content makes it suitable for keto and low-carb diets. Rich in essential nutrients like vitamin D and selenium, this option delivers both flavor and functional nutrition for balanced eating.
howToOrder: Select Glazed Salmon as your protein when building a custom bowl or pita at CAVA. Choose your preferred base, then add the salmon for an additional $4.50 to $5.50. Layer on your favorite dips, spreads, and toppings to create a personalized meal. You can also find it featured in select options on the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) for convenient pre-designed combinations.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Grilled Chicken at 250 calories and no upcharge, Glazed Salmon offers 70 more calories with premium omega-3 fats and richer flavor. Harissa Honey Chicken provides sweet-spicy notes at 260 calories for just $0.50 extra, while Grilled Steak delivers leaner protein at 170 calories. Braised Lamb offers similar richness at 210 calories. The salmon provides unique health benefits and distinctive taste worth the premium pricing.
whoShouldTry: Seafood enthusiasts seeking restaurant-quality fish in a fast-casual setting will love Glazed Salmon. Health-conscious diners following Mediterranean, keto, or high-protein diets find it perfectly aligned with their goals. Those looking to increase omega-3 intake or diversify from chicken will appreciate this flavorful alternative. Anyone wanting a premium protein upgrade that delivers both exceptional taste and nutritional benefits should consider this option.
worthTrying: Glazed Salmon absolutely merits the premium price for its superior quality, rich flavor, and impressive nutritional profile. The savory herb glaze elevates it beyond standard grilled proteins, delivering restaurant-caliber taste in a customizable format. With heart-healthy omega-3s, substantial protein, and minimal carbs, it supports various health goals. For seafood lovers and health-conscious diners seeking a satisfying, nutrient-dense meal, this premium option delivers exceptional value and delicious Mediterranean-inspired dining.

faqs.q: How much does Glazed Salmon cost at CAVA?
faqs.a: Glazed Salmon costs an additional $4.50 to $5.50 above the base price of your bowl or pita, depending on your location and portion size. This premium protein upgrade is priced higher than standard options due to the quality of the fish and preparation.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Glazed Salmon?
faqs.a: CAVA Glazed Salmon contains 320 calories per serving with 23g protein, 23g fat, and 5g carbohydrates. This makes it a protein-rich, low-carb option that fits well into various dietary plans including keto and Mediterranean diets.

faqs.q: What is the glaze on CAVA salmon made of?
faqs.a: The Glazed Salmon features a savory herb glaze made with aromatic herbs and seasonings that complement the natural flavor of the baked salmon. The proprietary blend enhances the fish with Mediterranean-inspired flavors without overwhelming its delicate taste.

faqs.q: Is Glazed Salmon healthier than chicken at CAVA?
faqs.a: Glazed Salmon offers unique health benefits with omega-3 fatty acids, vitamin D, and selenium that chicken does not provide. While it has 70 more calories than Grilled Chicken, the healthy fats support heart health and the protein content is similar at 23g, making both excellent choices for different nutritional goals.
